response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Full Stack Engineer with a strong background in TypeScript, Node.js, and React. He easily exceeds the 6+ years of experience requirement and brings highly relevant niche skills, including recent hands-on experience with AI agent infrastructure and MCP. Furthermore, his deep commitment to testing (TDD, authoring test frameworks) and cloud/containerization (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker) perfectly aligns with the role's architectural and quality demands.
strengths: Extensive background in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, alongside Java for backend services.
Direct experience building AI agent infrastructure and working with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Exceptional testing expertise, including TDD practices, creating custom test runners, and organizing testing workshops.
concerns: Lacks explicit mention of Nest.js and Vitest, though his Node.js and testing fundamentals are strong enough to adapt quickly.
Significant past focus on DLang, which is outside the required tech stack.
Currently holds a Staff Engineer title, so a Senior Developer role might represent a reduction in scope or seniority.
